header.name: Electronic System Design
header.description: The aim of the course is to develop an appreciation and understanding of the processes for design of electronic instruments, gadgets and systems through a hands-on project approach. The course outcomes include (a) the ability to plan and partition the user requirement of any electronic gadget or system in smaller, manageable building blocks and then (b) implement them using contemporary available technology, including microcontrollers, sensors, input devices and output actuators in a professional enclosure with suitable user interface; (c) select and program microcontroller platforms based on user requirements (d) design suitable power supply for the system (e) debug and document the entire system.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: To recognise electronic components and circuits as critical parts of hardware building blocks that make a gadget/product.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students learn about Embedded System Ecosystem including open-source hardware, Software and Toolchains relevant for building MCU based designs

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to recognise appropriate sensors, processors and programming requirements, output indicators and actuators together with suitable power supply for building standalone electronic products.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to build and test a simple standalone gadget/instrument in a professional format and to document the build process to create a user manual.
